name: adr183-continuation-native-26
result: Native pass of ADR-189 with ADR-191. The continuation provisioned all 68 public roles, including permission-accept and permission-audit, then ran the owner selection. It applied the shipped-CRD permission guard and published the permission projection under one retained bracket. The launched hub-worker's fourth child then opened the projection and verified both logins. It ran the binding reconciler against the actual guard (non-administrator dry-run CREATE denied) and published the authority audits through the provider-held audit credential under authority/v1/. Permission stream 091d0d24-... was fresh with 2 acknowledged authority audits. The bootstrap hook replay and the second continuation then passed unchanged (ADR-187). Subtest 474.0 s.
scope: Real kind API, OpenBao, SeaweedFS S3 and PostgreSQL; empty binding set (no initial review). No retention/cleanup of the authority outbox yet (ADR-189 decision 8), no capacity, no public workflow.
